subject: A rich, colorful product-explainer illustration: a large mobile phone mockup in the center showing the actual link-in-bio hub app, surrounded by labeled feature callout cards connected to specific parts of the phone screen with thin lines — so a viewer understands what the product does just by looking at the image. Flat vector SaaS marketing illustration, not photorealistic.

background.type: solid dark base, but NOT empty — filled with intentional color, not a bare black canvas
background.base_color: #14161A to #1B1E24 subtle vertical gradient (near-black, not pure flat black)
accent_fills: one large, soft, blurred cyan-blue blob (#54E0FF/#29ADFF, ~15% opacity) glowing behind the upper-left area, fully contained within that quadrant, soft edges fading to nothing before reaching other elements
one large, soft, blurred warm amber/coral blob (#FBBF24 or #FF8A5B, ~10% opacity) glowing behind the lower-right area, same soft-contained treatment
background.note: The background should read as rich and designed, not stark or mostly-empty. These are intentional soft color pools placed IN THE BACKGROUND ONLY — they must never touch or fringe the edges of the phone or cards themselves (no glow halo wrapping around any subject's outline).

art_style: clean flat vector UI illustration with real color
flat mobile phone mockup (rounded-rect device frame, flat screen, no glossy reflections)
flat matte cards, no glass, no chrome bevel
hard crisp edges, axis-aligned cards, phone can sit straight or with a very slight (max 3-4deg) natural tilt
flat 2D icons, thin consistent stroke weight
editorial, premium, colorful — think a well-designed app-store feature graphic or product explainer, not a moody dark-mode screenshot

color_palette.phone_frame: flat #0F1113 device body, flat #18181A screen background
color_palette.connector_lines: flat solid #54E0FF at 60% opacity, thin (1.5-2px), right-angle bends like a circuit diagram
color_palette.warm_accent: #FF8A5B (used sparingly for one card/background blob only)
color_palette.restriction: No purple or indigo anywhere. Every other color above is welcome — this should feel colorful and varied, not monochrome.

composition.layout: large phone mockup as the vertical centerpiece, roughly 45% of the frame height. 4-5 small labeled callout cards arranged around it (upper-left, upper-right, lower-left, lower-right, one directly beside the phone), each connected to a specific point on the phone screen by a thin right-angle line ending in a small dot on the phone. Composition should feel full and rich — minimize large empty gaps.

screen_content: small circular logo badge near the top (simple flat rounded-square scan-frame glyph, blue with red accent)
one bold white text line: 'Grand Cafe & Bakery' (real, legible, large enough to render cleanly)
one thin muted-gray subtitle line beneath it
a solid flat WhatsApp-green pill button with a chat-bubble icon and the real bold label 'Order on WhatsApp'
a solid flat dark pill button with an amber star icon and the real bold label 'Google Reviews'
a small QR code icon/badge near the bottom of the screen representing the share/QR action

elements.type: small flat rounded card, positioned beside the phone's QR badge
elements.connects_to: the QR badge near the bottom of the phone screen
elements.content: a real, correctly-structured flat QR code pattern in solid cyan #54E0FF with visible finder squares, plus one real short bold caption beneath it: 'Scan to visit'

elements.type: small flat rounded card, upper-left, connected to the WhatsApp button on the phone
elements.content: small flat white chat-bubble icon plus one real short bold caption: 'WhatsApp Ordering'

elements.type: small flat rounded card, upper-right, connected to the Reviews button on the phone
elements.content: small flat amber star icon plus one real short bold caption: '5-Star Reviews'

elements.type: small flat rounded card, lower-left, connected to the top of the phone
elements.content: tiny emerald live-dot plus one real short bold caption: '247 scans this week'

elements.type: small flat rounded card, lower-right, connected to the logo badge on the phone
elements.content: small flat lock or infinity icon in warm accent color, plus one real short bold caption: 'Never expires'

lighting_and_atmosphere.shadow_style: soft, small, ordinary drop shadow beneath the phone and beneath each card — short blur radius, low opacity, like a standard product-shot shadow, not a glow.
lighting_and_atmosphere.glow_scope: background accent color pools only (see background.accent_fills) — no glow hugging or outlining any card/phone edge.
lighting_and_atmosphere.overall_mood: colorful, informative, premium product-explainer graphic — a viewer should understand the product from this image alone

typography_note: Real, short, bold, legible text IS wanted this time: the phone's business name and both button labels, plus one short caption per callout card. Keep every piece of text SHORT (2-4 words max) and set in a simple bold sans-serif at a large-enough size to render cleanly — this is proven to work when text is short and bold rather than long or small.

technical_specs.aspect_ratio: 4:5 (portrait, tall enough for a full phone mockup)

negative_prompt: no glow or color fringing directly on the phone or card edges
no glass/glossy/chrome bevel reflections on the phone or cards
no mostly-empty flat black background — background must feel designed and colorful per the accent_fills
no photorealistic hands or humans holding the phone
no curved freeform connector lines — right-angle bends only
no long paragraphs of text, no attempted body copy — captions only, 2-4 words each
no overlapping cards on top of each other
reference_direction: Combine two things that already worked: (1) the clean hub-and-spoke connector-line structure with short bold real text, and (2) a phone-mockup product shot with labeled feature callouts (like an app-store feature graphic). Richer and more colorful than a stark dark diagram, but still flat, clean, and legible — not glossy, not neon, not a messy glow halo.
